description: GD-RHCR Experiment Metrics Schema — Person D defines, Persons B and C write to it.

run_level_csv.description: One row per experiment run. All fields mandatory unless marked optional.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run started

columns.name: thread_count
columns.description: Number of threads used (1 for sequential)

columns.name: agent_count
columns.description: Number of agents in the simulation

columns.name: solver_runtime_ms
columns.description: Wall-clock time spent in the solver only

columns.name: num_groups
columns.description: Number of spatial groups (1 for sequential)

columns.name: max_group_solve_ms
columns.description: Max solve time across groups per episode

columns.name: deadline_satisfaction_rate
columns.description: Fraction of tasks completed before deadline

columns.name: avg_tardiness
columns.description: Mean tardiness across all overdue tasks (0 if none)

columns.name: num_tasks_overdue
columns.description: Count of tasks that missed their deadline

task_level_csv.description: One row per task per run. Written by Person B's task tracking module.

columns.name: task_id
columns.description: Unique task identifier within the run

columns.name: release_time
columns.description: Timestep when the task was generated

columns.name: deadline
columns.description: Timestep by which the task should be completed

columns.name: assigned_agent
columns.description: Agent ID assigned to this task (-1 if unassigned)

columns.name: completion_time
columns.description: Timestep when task was completed (-1 if incomplete)

columns.name: tardiness
columns.description: max(0, completion_time - deadline); 0 if on time or incomplete

episode_level_csv.description: One row per replanning episode. Written by Person C's parallel core.

columns.name: timestep
columns.description: Simulation timestep when this episode started

columns.name: solve_time_ms
columns.description: Total wall-clock solver time for this episode
